αἰνέω: (to tell;) to praise, approve, acquiesce in
βλέπω: to see, have the power of sight
βοηθέω: to come to aid, to succour, assist, aid
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
γιγνώσκω: to learn to know, to perceive, mark, learn
δύω: (trans.) cause to enter or sink (dunk); (intr.) enter; get into; sink; set (of sun/stars)
εὐνάω: put to sleep, place in ambush
θάπτω: to bury, to honour with funeral rites
καταλέγω: recount, tell at length and in order; enrol, enlist
καταπαύω: to lay to rest, put an end to
κηρύσσω: to be a herald, officiate as herald
κλίνω: to make to bend, slope; recline
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
λάμπω: to give light, shine, beam, be bright, brilliant, radiant
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather

μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μεταγιγνώσκω: to change one’s mind, to repent
μεταδίδωμι: to give part of, give a share of
μεταχωρέω: to go to another place, to withdraw, migrate, emigrate
μηνύω: to disclose what is secret, reveal, betray
νομίζω: to have as a custom; to believe
οἰκτίρω: to pity, feel pity for, have pity upon
παρίημι: to pass over, let go, relax, yield, allow
παραπείθω: to persuade gradually, win over, beguile
πελάζω: to approach, come near, draw near
περάω: to drive right through; pass, penetrate
πορεύω: to make to go, carry, convey
προβαίνω: to step on, step forward, advance
προξενέω: to be proxenos; to procure, to be a patron, protector
προσάπτω: to fasten to, attach, grant, ascribe
προσέρχομαι: to come or go to, approach
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προτίθημι: to place before, to propose, to prefer
προφαίνω: to bring forth, bring to light, shew forth, manifest, display
πόρω: pres. not attested; aor. to furnish, offer; perf. it is fated
σείω: to shake, move to and fro
σημαίνω: to shew by a sign, indicate, make known, point out
σπεύδω: to set a-going, to urge on, hasten, quicken
στηρίζω: to make fast, prop, fix, set
συμπράσσω: to join or help in doing
συνάγω: to bring together, gather together, collect, convene
συνάπτω: to tie, join together, meet in battle
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
τλάω: to take upon oneself, to bear, suffer, undergo
τυγχάνω: (with gen.) to hit the mark, to get; (with pple) to happen to, to actually
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φροντίζω: to think, consider, reflect, take thought, have a care, give heed
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
χωρέω: give way, draw back, retire, withdraw
ἀθρέω: to look at, gaze at, observe, perceive
ἀνίημι: to send up; let go, abate
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναβοάω: to shout aloud, utter a loud cry
ἀναλαμβάνω: to take up, take into one’s hands
ἀναψύχω: to cool, to revive by fresh air, to refresh
ἀνταποδίδωμι: to give back, repay, tender in repayment
ἀξιόω: to think worthy of; to expect
ἀπεῖπον: to speak out, tell out, declare (Hom.), deny, refuse, forbid
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐκλείπω: to leave out, omit, pass over
ἐμπίμπρημι: to kindle, burn, set on fire
ἐνέπω: to tell, tell of, relate, describe
ἐξίστημι: to put out of its place, to change
ἐπέχω: to hold on; hold out; hold back; adjourn; occupy
ἐπαμύνω: to come to aid, defend, assist
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ὀπάζω: to make to follow, send with
ὀροθύνω: to stir up, rouse, urge on, excite
ὀτρύνω: to stir up, rouse, egg on, spur on, encourage
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑποβάλλω: throw, put, lay under; bring in as one’s own
